verdict.rationale: TeamViewer is a remote-access and IT-management SaaS with a Web API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question. The pack shows only a Web API and a 30-day free trial. A trial is not an isolated sandbox that keeps tests away from production data, and nothing documents a sandbox, test tenant, or dry-run mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
